evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: The requirement of a signed manifest before shipping appeals to security and stability — keeping what works protected from uncontrolled deployment.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by prior unsigned artifacts reaching staging frames the value as preventing recurrence — conservation of security and stability.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: Asserting a required gate for deploys appeals to security and control — conservation of stable, protected release processes.
Extending the gate's scope to both staging and production reinforces the conservation value — protecting all deployment environments with the same security control.
Naming an owner for the gate assigns accountability for maintaining the security control — conservation of ordered, owned process.
